summary: NO-GO, with 3 blockers. Both creatives are approved but saved as PAUSED, so the campaign would serve nothing when switched on. The "Account created" conversion is linked to the two older campaigns but not to this one, so a WEBSITE_CONVERSION campaign would have nothing to optimise for. And the ad URL has no trailing slash: the site's 301 redirect drops the UTMs, so GA4 would not credit the visits or sign-ups to the campaign. Tracking itself is healthy: GA4 sees 88% of Search Console clicks and sign_up fired 491 times in 14 days. Also fix the daily budget (USD 40 set, 60 planned) and look at the 3.1 s mobile LCP.
